user.title: Configure Bagwatch
user.description: Set up the market data providers. Bagwatch supports Twelve Data and an experimental Yahoo Finance mode for stocks, ETFs and FX. Yahoo Finance is selected by default. Crypto can use the primary provider only, or CoinGecko first and then fall back to the selected primary provider.

data.api_key: Twelve Data API key (required only for Twelve Data)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Bagwatch
reconfigure.description: Update provider settings for this portfolio.

data.api_key: Twelve Data API key (required only for Twelve Data)

error.invalid_configuration: The provider settings are invalid. Check the selected provider and API keys.

error.invalid_transaction: The transaction data is invalid or incomplete.
error.legacy_positions_present: Delete the old Bagwatch positions first, then recreate them as transactions.

user.title: Add transaction
user.description: Add one buy or sell transaction. Bagwatch will calculate the current position, average cost and realized P/L from the full transaction history.

data.name: Display name
data.fx_rate: FX rate at trade (base per 1 unit)

data_description.symbol: User-facing symbol, for example MSFT.US, PKN.PL, ACWI or BTC.
data_description.name: Optional friendly name used for the asset device in Home Assistant.
data_description.asset_type: Choose the asset class for provider mapping.
data_description.transaction_type: Buy adds to the open position. Sell reduces it and books realized P/L.
data_description.currency: Currency of the executed trade, for example USD or PLN. Use GBX for trades priced in pence.
data_description.trade_date: Execution date used to order the transaction history.
data_description.fees_total: Optional fees for this single trade.
data_description.fx_rate: Optional, only for trades in a currency other than your base currency. The exchange rate this trade actually settled at, as base currency per 1 unit of the trade currency. Example: base EUR, you bought a US stock and paid 0.92 EUR per 1 USD, so enter 0.92. This fixes the cost basis so it stops drifting with today's rate. Leave empty to keep using the live rate.
data_description.settlement_base_amount: Optional alternative to the FX rate, for foreign-currency trades. The total your broker charged in your base currency for quantity x unit price (fees excluded). Example: base EUR, you bought 10 shares at 50 USD (= 500 USD) and your broker debited 465 EUR, so enter 465. Bagwatch works out the rate from it. Use this or the FX rate, not both.
data_description.provider_symbol: Optional exact provider ticker. For CoinGecko you can use cg:bitcoin. For Yahoo Finance you can use prefixes like yf:PKN.WA or yahoo:BTC-USD.
